name: PII Protection Policy
description:
Thematic policy for personally identifiable information: everything that identifies a natural person or the organization they belong to. Membership is category-driven — the whole of the government, personal and organization categories, so a new rule in any of them is covered the day it ships.

This policy is jurisdiction-free by design (D17). It resolves every PII rule in the catalog, including country-specific national IDs and address formats; the configuration's region lens narrows that set to the jurisdictions the user actually operates in before any matching work happens. There is no "US PII" or "EU PII" policy — WHAT to protect is the policy, WHERE is the config, WHY is the profile/overlay.

Scope: Personally identifiable information — global, category-driven
